description: This file contains utility functions for formatting and parsing text in Mattermost, including handling mentions, hashtags, emojis, markdown, and converting URLs to links. It defines classes, types, and functions for processing message content with highlighting, tokenization, and HTML sanitization.

classes.name: Tokens
classes.description: A specialized Map class for managing tokens during text formatting, with a limit on size to prevent excessive tokenization.

methods.name: isFormatTokenLimitError
methods.description: Checks if an error is due to exceeding the maximum token limit during formatting.

methods.name: isChannelNamesMap
methods.description: Type guard to verify if a value conforms to the ChannelNamesMap structure.

methods.name: formatText
methods.description: Main function to format text with options, including markdown, emoji, mentions, hashtags, and links.

methods.name: doFormatText
methods.description: Performs core token replacement and highlighting operations on text.

methods.name: sanitizeHtml
methods.description: Sanitizes HTML special characters in a string.

methods.name: autolinkEmails
methods.description: Converts email addresses in text into HTML links, replacing them with tokens.

methods.name: autoLinkSumOfMembersMentions
methods.description: Replaces sum of members mentions with tokens.

methods.name: autoPlanMentions
methods.description: Replaces plan mentions with tokens.

methods.name: autolinkAtMentions
methods.description: Replaces @mentions with tokens, including special mentions like @channel.

methods.name: allAtMentions
methods.description: Returns all @mention strings in the text.

methods.name: autolinkChannelMentions
methods.description: Replaces channel mentions with links or tokens based on channel map.

methods.name: escapeReplaceSpecialPatterns
methods.description: Escapes special characters in replacement patterns.

methods.name: escapeHtml
methods.description: Escapes HTML special characters.

methods.name: convertEntityToCharacter
methods.description: Converts HTML entities back to characters.

methods.name: highlightCurrentMentions
methods.description: Highlights mentions in text based on mention keys.

methods.name: highlightWithoutNotificationKeywords
methods.description: Highlights specified keywords without notification.

methods.name: parseSearchTerms
methods.description: Parses search term string into individual search patterns.

methods.name: convertSearchTermToRegex
methods.description: Converts a search term into a regex pattern for highlighting.

methods.name: highlightSearchTerms
methods.description: Highlights search terms in text based on search patterns.

methods.name: replaceTokens
methods.description: Replaces token aliases in text with their corresponding HTML values.

methods.name: handleUnicodeEmoji
methods.description: Replaces unicode emojis with image or span markup.

methods.name: fixedCharCodeAt
methods.description: Gets the Unicode code point of a character, handling surrogate pairs.
